model_report_source: requested via -m (codex exec does not echo it)

judgments.justification: “highest Recall@5 … on five of the six” with only a BGE exception entails wins on all three RankT5 datasets.
“five of the six” and only Musique/BGE below incorrectly treat HotpotQA/BGE as a win; Method M also trailed EMDR there.
“largest improvement on HotpotQA/RankT5” is wrong: the largest RankT5 EM gain was 0.4 on Musique, not 0.3 on HotpotQA.
The aggregate matched-or-exceeded statement does not distinguish the HotpotQA tie from the Musique outright win.
“slightly below PDist” and “slightly below LOOP” establish that Method M did not outperform across every dataset and backbone.
“only single runs were performed and no statistical tests were reported” correctly identifies the evidence limitations and unquantified reliability.
“not on Musique with either backbone” is false for RankT5: its own cited values, 57.9 versus 55.0, show Method M was highest.
It reports a BGE win on 2WikiHop and “not” winning on Musique or HotpotQA, matching the mixed Recall@5 result.
“highest exact match” on all three RankT5 datasets is supported by the reported comparisons, whose gains are 0.3, 0.4, and 0.2.
It reports Musique/BGE as highest, HotpotQA/BGE “tied with PDist,” and 2WikiHop/BGE below LOOP.
“did not consistently outperform … across all datasets and backbones” correctly summarizes the dataset- and backbone-dependent losses and tie.
“single runs without variance estimates or significance tests” directly reports all specified limitations.
“HotpotQA/RankT5, Musique/RankT5, 2WikiHop/RankT5” are correctly listed among the four configurations where Method M had highest Recall@5.
It correctly reports 2WikiHop/BGE among the wins and Method M “below the best baseline” on HotpotQA/BGE and Musique/BGE.
“exceeded the best baseline exact match” on all three named RankT5 configurations correctly reports the uniformly highest RankT5 answer-generation results.
“below the best baseline” on HotpotQA/BGE is wrong; Method M tied PDist there at 60.9.
“below … on the remaining two” mischaracterizes the HotpotQA/BGE generator tie as a loss, altering the stated cross-backbone pattern.
“only single runs were performed and no statistical tests were reported” correctly conveys that reliability was not quantified.
